Recipe Box

Save your own recipes with ingredients and steps, search them anytime.

📖 How to use

  1. Name your recipe and pick a category.
  2. List ingredients and steps, one per line each.
  3. Click Save Recipe.
  4. Click a card to expand it; search to find recipes fast.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add a recipe?

Give the recipe a name, list one ingredient per line, then the steps (also one per line), and click Save Recipe.

How does search work?

The search box matches the recipe name, ingredients and steps at once.

How do I view a full recipe?

Click a recipe card to expand its full ingredients and steps. The × button deletes it.

Where are recipes stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device, no account needed.
